one_liner: Customer operations platform: shared inbox/help desk with multichannel messaging, automation, and AI.
access_notes: Free developer accounts provide a sandbox and allow creating apps, OAuth clients, and API tokens without contacting support.
blocker_notes: You can build and ship an OAuth-based connector today using self-serve developer creds. For broad distribution via Front’s App Store, there’s a partner publishing process and review.
